summary: Bound sectionMatrix on a ball around (Z, Zᴴ) in the product space, then the Schwarz-type Lipschitz bound for holomorphic maps gives the derivative bound.

steps.lean:
have b {x y} (hp : (x, y) ∈ ball (Z, Zᴴ) r) : _ ∧ ‖sectionMatrix x y‖ ≤ P ^ 12 := by
    simp [IsBoundedInCell, ← (y - _).l2_opNorm_conjTranspose] at hp H
    obtain ⟨⟨o, _, _, q⟩, _, o', _, -⟩ := H _ hp.1, (by simp [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonempty] :
      ∀ s, ‖diagLast (𝔰 := 𝔰) s‖ ≤ 1 + ‖s‖), by simpa using H _ hp.2
    use differentiableAt_sectionMatrix_uncurry _ o o'; delta sectionMatrix sectionFrame
      sectionCoeff; trans; repeat' first
      | apply_assumption (transparency := .reducible) [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg, norm_add_le_of_le,
        norm_sub_le_of_le, norm_inclMatrix_le_one, (l2_opNorm_mul ..).trans] | positivity | simp
              [Injective, norm_cpow_of_imp, ← by simpa using sqrt_eq_rpow] | rfl
    grw [← (_ : 4⁻¹ * cornerDefect x ≤ ‖_‖), norm_sub_le, norm_mul, o.2, o'.2,
      sqrt_le_self_iff.2] <;> simp [o]; grw [q, ← sub_nonneg]
    obtain ⟨t, _, rfl⟩ := exists_nonneg_add_of_le hP; ring; bound
    grw [← norm_sub_norm_le, norm_mul, o'.2, norm_one]; nlinarith
steps.claim: b: for (x, y) within r of (Z, Zᴴ), (Z', W') ↦ sectionMatrix(Z', W') is complex differentiable at (x, y) and ‖sectionMatrix(x, y)‖ ≤ P¹².

steps.lean:
simp [IsBoundedInCell, ← (y - _).l2_opNorm_conjTranspose] at hp H
    obtain ⟨⟨o, _, _, q⟩, _, o', _, -⟩ := H _ hp.1, (by simp [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonempty] :
      ∀ s, ‖diagLast (𝔰 := 𝔰) s‖ ≤ 1 + ‖s‖), by simpa using H _ hp.2
steps.claim: Since ‖y − Zᴴ‖ = ‖yᴴ − Z‖, both x and yᴴ lie within r of Z, so H gives: x ∈ Ω, ‖x⁻¹‖, ‖x‖ ≤ P, δ(x)^{−1/2} ≤ P (q), and yᴴ ∈ Ω (o') with ‖y⁻¹‖, ‖y‖ ≤ P; also ‖diagLast(s)‖ ≤ 1 + |s| for every s.

steps.lean:
use differentiableAt_sectionMatrix_uncurry _ o o'; delta sectionMatrix sectionFrame
      sectionCoeff; trans; repeat' first
      | apply_assumption (transparency := .reducible) [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg, norm_add_le_of_le,
        norm_sub_le_of_le, norm_inclMatrix_le_one, (l2_opNorm_mul ..).trans] | positivity | simp
              [Injective, norm_cpow_of_imp, ← by simpa using sqrt_eq_rpow] | rfl
steps.claim: Differentiability is differentiableAt_sectionMatrix_uncurry. For the norm, unfold sectionMatrix, sectionFrame and sectionCoeff and bound every sum and product by the triangle inequality and submultiplicativity, with ‖F_𝔰‖, ‖F'_𝔰‖ ≤ 1 (norm_inclMatrix_le_one) and the bounds of 1.1; what remains is a bound for |s|⁻¹, s = √(1 − ξ(x)ξ(y)).

steps.lean:
grw [← (_ : 4⁻¹ * cornerDefect x ≤ ‖_‖), norm_sub_le, norm_mul, o.2, o'.2,
      sqrt_le_self_iff.2] <;> simp [o]; grw [q, ← sub_nonneg]
steps.claim: Use the lower bound ¼δ(x) ≤ |1 − ξ(x)ξ(y)| (proved in 1.5) together with |ξ(x)|, |ξ(y)| < 1 and δ(x)^{−1/2} ≤ P to reduce the norm bound to an inequality between powers of P.

steps.lean: obtain ⟨t, _, rfl⟩ := exists_nonneg_add_of_le hP; ring; bound
steps.claim: That inequality holds for P ≥ 8: write P = 8 + t with t ≥ 0, expand and bound.

steps.lean: grw [← norm_sub_norm_le, norm_mul, o'.2, norm_one]; nlinarith

⟨(b (by simpa)).2, norm_fderiv_le_of_lip' ℝ (by bound) (.mono (ball_mem_nhds Z hr) fun y ↦
    by simpa [two_mul, ← conjTranspose_sub] using
    norm_sub_le_of_holomorphic_bdd (Prod.rec @b) (y, yᴴ))⟩
steps.claim: At (x, y) = (Z, Zᴴ), b gives ‖sectionMatrix(Z)‖ ≤ P¹². On the ball of radius r about Z, Z' ↦ sectionMatrix(Z', Z'ᴴ) is the restriction of a holomorphic map bounded by P¹² on the ball of radius r about (Z, Zᴴ), hence ‖sectionMatrix(y) − sectionMatrix(Z)‖ ≤ (2P¹²/r)·‖y − Z‖ for every y in that ball (norm_sub_le_of_holomorphic_bdd, ‖(y, yᴴ) − (Z, Zᴴ)‖ = ‖y − Z‖: a bound relative to the centre Z, not a two-point Lipschitz bound on the ball); so its real derivative at Z has norm at most 2P¹²/r.
